info.name: PingDartDB v0.5.0 Enterprise API Collection
info.description: Official comprehensive Postman Collection for PingDartDB AI-Native Distributed Database Engine. Covers Universal SQL, DDL Tables/Columns, User Permissions, Document API, REST CRUD, HNSW Vectors, BM25 Hybrid Search, AI Cognitive Memory, Labeled Graph, Multi-Tenant Governance, Enterprise Security & RBAC, Universal Migration, Backup/Restore & PITR, Observability, and Storage Engine.

item.name: 1. Authentication & Session
item.description: Login and token generation for root administrator and provisioned users.

request.description: Authenticates with root admin credentials. The Postman test script automatically stores the returned session token into the collection variable `authToken` for subsequent requests.

exec: console.log("Auth token updated in collection variables:", jsonData.token);

item.name: 2. User Management & Database Permissions
item.description: Manage database user accounts, passwords, allowed IP addresses/hosts, and grant/revoke database permissions.

request.description: Lists all database users, host masks, active roles, and assigned permissions.

item.name: 2.2 Create Database User with Password & Host

request.description: Creates a new database user account with password and host permission (e.g. '%' for any host or IP subnet).
Grants full administrative permissions on target database to the user.
Grants read-only access (SELECT queries) on target database to the user.
Grants read and write access (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on target database.
Revokes permissions on target database from the user.
Changes user's password or updates allowed IP connection mask.
Deletes a database user account.

item.name: 3. SQL Query Engine & DDL (Any Query API)
item.description: Direct SQL execution engine. Pass ANY valid SQL statement (CREATE DATABASE, CREATE TABLE with columns, SHOW TABLES, INSERT, SELECT, JOINS, ALTER, DROP) directly in the 'query' field.

item.name: 3.1 Run ANY Custom SQL Query (Universal Template)

request.description: Universal SQL Query endpoint: write and run ANY SQL command directly in the 'query' string parameter.
Lists all registered databases in the engine.
Creates a new logical database catalog.
Lists all tables in the active database along with row count and storage engine type.

item.name: 3.5 Create Table with Columns, Constraints & Types

request.description: Creates a structured relational table with custom column data types (INT, STRING, FLOAT, BOOLEAN, TIMESTAMP), AUTO_INCREMENT, PRIMARY KEY, NOT NULL, and DEFAULT constraints.
Inserts records into the specified table.
Selects all columns and rows from table.

item.name: 3.8 Select with WHERE, ORDER BY, LIMIT

request.description: Executes filtered, sorted, and paginated SELECT query.
Analytical aggregation query using vectorized columnar engine.
Inspects Cost-Based Optimizer (CBO) plan selection, index usage, and execution timing.
Drops table and cleans up data, schema, and secondary indexes.
Drops an entire database catalog and all its associated tables.
Executes structured query via PRD Section 6.5 REST interface.
Executes structured query via alternate data endpoint.

item.name: 4. Document Store API (Firebase / Mongo)
item.description: NoSQL document filtering, geospatial proximity queries, and flexible schema lookups.

request.description: Queries records in a collection using declarative filters.
Finds entities located within radius_km using spatial geohash indexing.

item.name: 5. REST Data CRUD (Directus / Supabase)
item.description: Direct REST table endpoints supporting postgREST-style filtering operators (eq, gt, in, like, etc.).

request.description: Lists rows from table with paging and field projection.
Inserts a new row or document into the table.
Fetches a single row by primary key ID.
Updates specified columns of a row.
Soft/hard deletes a row by ID.

item.name: 6. Schema & Table Metadata
item.description: Table schema definitions, column listings, and catalog management.

request.description: Returns metadata for all tables in the database.
Creates a new schema definition programmatically.
Retrieves column and constraint details for a specific table.
Clears all records in a table while retaining schema definition.
Drops table and associated index files.

item.name: 7. Vector Engine & AI Search
item.description: HNSW approximate nearest neighbor search, BM25 full-text indexing, and reciprocal rank fusion hybrid search.

request.description: Executes vector cosine/Euclidean distance search over HNSW index.
Performs BM25 ranked full-text search.
Combines dense vector and sparse lexical results via alpha weighting (0.0 = BM25 only, 1.0 = Vector only).

item.name: 8. AI Cognitive Memory & Agents
item.description: Episodic, Semantic, Working, and Long-Term cognitive memory subsystem with automatic sleep consolidation.

request.description: Stores an experience or fact into the AI cognitive memory store.
Retrieves relevant memories based on contextual session similarity.
Triggers memory consolidation to compress ephemeral observations into long-term semantic knowledge.

item.name: 9. Graph Database Engine (Neo4j Style)
item.description: Labeled Property Graph engine supporting nodes, directed typed edges, neighbor traversal, and shortest path finding.

request.description: Upserts a graph node with labels and properties.
Creates a directed relationship between two nodes.
Calculates the shortest graph traversal path between two nodes.
Returns adjacent neighbors of a node filtered by edge type and target label.

item.name: 10. Indexes & Secondary Indexing
item.description: B+Tree secondary and unique indexing for sub-millisecond point lookups and range scans.

request.description: Builds a composite B+Tree secondary index on specified table fields.
Lists all active B+Tree indexes in the target database.
Returns page split, depth, and entry counts for indexes.
Deallocates index structure and frees disk space.

item.name: 11. CDC & Change Data Capture
item.description: Durable WAL event streaming and downstream consumer replay.

request.description: Replays mutation events from the durable write-ahead commit log.

item.name: 12. Multi-Tenant Governance & RLS
item.description: Hardware tenant quota isolation (Storage, Vectors, QPS) and Row-Level Security policies.

request.description: Provisions an isolated tenant container with hard enforcement limits.
Returns all registered tenants and their quota utilization.
Configures row-level security policy restricting data visibility by active tenant.
Enables or disables Row-Level Security evaluation on a table.

item.name: 13. Cluster & Raft Consensus
item.description: Raft consensus engine, cluster membership, consistent hash sharding, and multi-node topology.

request.description: Returns cluster member list, Raft state (Leader/Follower), term, and shard allocations.
Directs current node to join an existing Raft cluster via seed address.
Executes partition-level vector search across cluster shards.

item.name: 14. Enterprise Security & Access Control
item.description: Granular RBAC roles, scoped API key lifecycle, and AES-256-GCM envelope cryptographic service.

request.description: Issues a revocable service API key (prefix pd_live_).
Lists all provisioned API key metadata (secrets remain hashed).
Immediately revokes an active API key.
Defines a custom role with fine-grained permission flags.

body.raw:
{
  "token": "{{authToken}}",
  "name": "DataAnalystRole",
  "description": "Read-only access to analytics tables and vectors",
  "permissions": [
    "TableRead",
    "VectorSearch",
    "AuditRead"
  ],
  "scope": "global"
}

request.description: Lists all system and custom RBAC roles.
Encrypts arbitrary plaintext using engine's master envelope key.
Decrypts ciphertext hex string back into original plaintext.

item.name: 15. Universal Migration Framework
item.description: Zero-downtime ETL migration pipeline supporting MySQL dumps, PostgreSQL, MongoDB extended JSON, and CSV.

request.description: Spawns an asynchronous background migration job.
Returns all historical and running migration jobs.
Fetches live progress (processed rows, failed rows, throughput).
Verifies source-to-target checksums and schema conformity.
Resumes interrupted migration from last durable checkpoint.
Cancels an ongoing migration job.

item.name: 16. Backup & Disaster Recovery
item.description: Online point-in-time snapshots, PITR transaction replay, and encrypted Protobuf (.pb) packaging.

request.description: Freezes WAL and creates a verifiable storage snapshot.
Restores entire database state from a snapshot.
Replays WAL transactions up to an exact epoch millisecond timestamp.
Packages table data into a ZSTD-compressed, AES-256 encrypted .pb container.
Validates checksum, decrypts, and unpacks .pb backup.
Exports all tables as portable JSON documents.
Imports tables from JSON dump structure.

item.name: 17. Observability, Health & Diagnostics
item.description: Prometheus metrics, OpenTelemetry distributed traces, and slow query heuristics.

request.description: Returns high-level engine operational status and feature flags.
K8s liveness probe returning UP status.
K8s readiness probe verifying Raft leader election and storage engine readiness.
Standard Prometheus /metrics scrape endpoint.
Lists recent distributed traces.
Inspects full call tree and execution latency of a trace span.
Lists queries that exceeded slow query threshold with index optimization hints.

item.name: 18. Storage Engine (HBSE File Management)
item.description: Hybrid Block Storage Engine for object, image, and document binary storage with deduplication and CDC tracking.

request.description: Uploads a binary file to the storage engine.

formdata.description: Select any file or media to upload

request.description: Returns metadata for all files stored in the engine.
Retrieves size, MIME type, compression ratio, and download URL for a file.
Streams file binary directly.
Deletes file binary and metadata.

item.name: 19. Realtime WebSockets & Live Subscriptions (Firebase-like)
item.description: Live CDC table change events, presence tracking, and ephemeral channel broadcasts over WebSockets (ws://localhost:4650/v1/realtime or /ws).

request.description: Connect to the live WebSocket gateway at ws://localhost:4650/v1/realtime?token={{authToken}} or ws://localhost:4650/ws
Sends an authentication frame over WebSocket if token was not provided in initial handshake URL query params.
Subscribes to live CDC table changes (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE). If fetch_snapshot is true, immediately receives initial table state snapshot.
Cancels active subscription to table events.
Broadcasts an ephemeral message to all clients in a channel without writing to persistent storage.
Tracks online status. The server broadcasts presence_state and presence_diff (joins/leaves) to all channel participants.
Leaves a presence channel. Notifies all participants of departure.
Sends a keep-alive ping frame. The server responds immediately with a 'pong' event and epoch timestamp.
